name: Home Wrapped
description: Your home's year so far as year-in-review cards: summary, big numbers, top fives, leaderboard, trading card, from year-to-date Home Assistant entities. Home, Energy and Pets themes, four palettes. Drawn live or painted whole by GPT Image.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key
settings.help: For pictures of your own home, pets and stats. Blank uses the key under Settings › Generative AI (fal.ai, or OpenAI for GPT Image). Without any key the bundled pictures are used. Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys; it is only sent to fal.run.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widget may spend on pictures in a day, at GPT Image's listed price (about 20 US cents a picture). Each picture is painted once and kept. 0 is no limit.

cell_options.name: theme
cell_options.label: Theme
cell_options.help: Sets the title, the list headings, the main picture and the sample year.

choices.label: Cycle through them all, a new card each hour

cell_options.name: stat
cell_options.label: Which stat
cell_options.help: 1 for the first line under Stats, 2 for the second, and so on.

cell_options.name: render
cell_options.label: Render

choices.label: Live: drawn here, numbers always current
Painted: GPT Image paints the whole card (needs an AI key)

cell_options.help: Live sets every word and number itself, current on every refresh, with GPT Image's pictures. Painted has GPT Image paint the whole card, numbers included, from your real figures, about 20 US cents a card each time it repaints; until it is ready, without a key, or for the sample year, the card is drawn live.

cell_options.name: cadence
cell_options.label: Repaint
cell_options.help: A painted card keeps the numbers it was painted with until the next repaint. Changing a heading, a stat, the home, the pets, the theme or the palette repaints straight away.

cell_options.name: show_strip
cell_options.label: Print the figures along the foot
cell_options.help: The numbers the card was painted from, in small type, so a figure the painter got wrong is easy to spot (Repaint it from the widget's paintings page).

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank uses the theme's, such as Home Wrapped. The year follows it.

cell_options.name: stats
cell_options.label: Stats
cell_options.help:
One per line, up to six: a name, an equals sign and an entity holding the year so far. The first two go on the summary; each gets its own big-number card and picture. Units come from the entity (kWh rolls up to MWh, minutes to hours). Example:
Kettle boils = counter.kettle_boils_year
Solar generated = sensor.solar_energy_year

cell_options.name: list_a_title
cell_options.label: First list heading
cell_options.help: Blank uses the theme's, such as Top rooms.

cell_options.name: rows_a
cell_options.label: First list
cell_options.help: Name = entity per line, ranked biggest first and shown as each one's share of the total. For Top rooms, a yearly meter of time spent in each room.

cell_options.name: list_b_title
cell_options.label: Second list heading
cell_options.help: Blank uses the theme's, such as Top appliances.

cell_options.name: rows_b
cell_options.label: Second list
cell_options.help: Name = entity per line, ranked biggest first with their own numbers. Used by the summary and the leaderboard.

cell_options.name: card_name
cell_options.label: Trading card name
cell_options.help: Blank uses the theme's, such as Our House.

cell_options.name: home
cell_options.label: Your home, for the picture
cell_options.help: With an AI key, the main picture is painted for this, once: 'a weatherboard cottage with a veranda', 'a third-floor flat'. Blank keeps the bundled picture.

cell_options.name: pets
cell_options.label: Your pets, for the picture
cell_options.help: Such as 'a ginger cat and a black labrador'.

cell_options.name: grain
cell_options.label: Print grain
cell_options.help: A light paper grain over the card. Off gives flatter colour on a panel that dithers.
